title: Duellist's Prerogative

sources.title: Elegant Duellist
markers: | description = While your off-hand is empty, you score a [[Critical Hit]] when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional {{r|reaction}} per turn.

sources.title: Withering Cut
markers: | description = On a hit with a melee weapon, use a {{r|reaction}} to deal additional {{DamageType|Necrotic}} damage equal to your [[Proficiency Bonus]].

sources.title: Challenge to Duel
markers: | description = Challenge an enemy to attack only you, inflicting {{Cond|Bleeding}} on the target.

sources.title: Dueller's Enthusiasm
markers: | description = While you are not dual-wielding and your off hand is empty, you can make an additional melee attack with The Dueller.

summary: A +3 rapier. An empty off hand improves critical hits, adds a Reaction, and allows a bonus strike.

fields.Elegant Duellist: With an empty off hand, critical hits on 19–20 and gain one additional Reaction per turn. The threshold reduction stacks with similar effects.
fields.Withering Cut: On a melee weapon hit, spend a Reaction to deal Necrotic damage equal to proficiency bonus.
fields.Challenge to Duel: Bonus Action, range 30 ft. Wisdom save against weapon-action DC or Compelled to Duel for 3 turns. This variant does not need Concentration. Hits with the rapier against the challenged target can apply Bleeding for 3 turns on a failed DC 15 Constitution save.
fields.Dueller’s Enthusiasm: With an empty off hand, use a Bonus Action once per turn to attack with the rapier.
fields.Acquisition: Speak to Lora before rescuing Vanra to qualify for the quest reward.
fields.Base value: 1300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Extra damage: 1d4 Necrotic on hit, independent of whether the off hand is empty.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
